title: Starter Deck 28: GREEN/YELLOW Yamato

cards.name: Yamato
cards.text:
[Double Attack] (This card deals 2 damage.)
[Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, give up to 2 rested DON!! cards to 1 of your Characters.

cards.name: Inuarashi
cards.text: [DON!! x2][When Attacking] You may trash 1 card from your hand: K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost equal to or less than the number of your opponent's Life cards.

notes: DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP06 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.
